motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve the Consent Agenda. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Consent agenda approved
motions.summary: The council approved its consent agenda, the batch of items voted through together without separate discussion.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for residents — this is the routine batch vote the council uses to clear uncontested items in one step.

motions.item_title: Remand the Ordinance Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Title 6 and Title 17 to Establi…
motions.motion: Councilmember Gray moved to remand the Ordinance Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Title 6 and Title 17 to Establish Standards for Alternative Animal Management Plans and Update Related Zoning Provisions back to the Planning Commission to review additional changes. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Animal rules sent back for more work
motions.summary: The council sent proposed rules on alternative animal management plans, and the zoning that goes with them, back to the Planning Commission for further review.
motions.impact: If you keep animals on your property, nothing changes yet. The rules are still being rewritten and will have to come back to the council before anything takes effect.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Development Agreement with Stadion, LLC (aka Meta)
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Development Agreement with Stadion, LLC (aka Meta). Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Development agreement with Meta approved
motions.summary: The city approved a development agreement with Stadion, LLC — the company known as Meta — setting the terms for its Eagle Mountain project.
motions.impact: This sets the ground rules for what Meta may build here and what it owes the city. The motion doesn't list those terms, so residents won't see anything change day to day.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Third Amendment to the Water and Sewer Agreement with Stadion, LLC (aka Meta)
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Third Amendment to the Water and Sewer Agreement with Stadion, LLC (aka Meta). Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Water and sewer deal with Meta updated
motions.summary: The council approved a third change to the water and sewer agreement with Stadion, LLC — the company known as Meta.
motions.impact: This governs the water and sewer service the Meta site gets and on what terms. The motion doesn't say what the change does, so no effect on your household bill is stated.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Development Agreement with Meritage Homes at Harmony Subdivision
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Development Agreement with Meritage Homes at Harmony Subdivision. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Development deal for Harmony Subdivision homes
motions.summary: The city approved a development agreement with Meritage Homes setting the terms for the Harmony Subdivision.
motions.impact: This locks in the rules Meritage Homes must build to at Harmony. The motion itself doesn't state how many homes, what they cost, or when building starts, so there is nothing yet for neighbors to plan around.
